The '''''Razor''''' was a modified [[Dragonfly-class Imperial drop ship|''Dragonfly''-class Imperial drop ship]] used by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Vrath Xizor]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. It was later stolen by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]].
